_readme: Data for build/gen_assets.py. style_block is placeholder text; the real art bible (in progress) will replace it wholesale, which is exactly why it lives here and not inside a template string. Paths are relative to the repo root; reference_images may point into the git-ignored sources/private/.
style_block: PLACEHOLDER STYLE BLOCK -- replace once the art bible is signed off. Warm storybook 3D-film look (Pixar/Laika-adjacent), soft cel-shaded lighting, clean readable silhouettes, a Kutch/Gujarat folk-embroidery palette (indigo, mirror-work silver, marigold, madder red). No text, watermark or signature anywhere in frame.

templates.hand_pose:
{style}

Subject: a single human right hand and forearm only, nothing else in frame. Camera: {camera}. Pose: {pose}. Skin tone: warm medium brown. Sleeve: a boy's kurta cuff in indigo cotton with a narrow strip of Kutch mirror-work embroidery at the hem -- this is the master reference cuff every other hand pose and reskin must match. Background: flat, fully transparent, no shadow, no table, no other body parts in frame.
templates.hand_pose_from_ref:
{style}

Using the attached reference hand image for exact hand shape, skin tone, proportions and cuff style, draw the SAME hand in a new pose: {pose}. Camera: {camera}. Keep the cuff and its embroidery identical to the reference. Background: flat, fully transparent, hand and forearm only, no shadow, no other body parts.
templates.hand_reskin:
{style}

Take the attached reference hand image exactly as given: same hand shape, same finger positions, same camera angle, same scale and position in frame. Change ONLY the sleeve and wrist: {change}. Do not alter the hand's outline, proportions or pose in any way. Background stays flat, fully transparent.
templates.ingredient_state:
{style}

Subject: {item}, {state}, isolated on a flat, fully transparent background. View: {view}, matching the scale and lighting of other cooking-station props. A soft contact shadow directly beneath it, nothing else in frame.
templates.ingredient_state_from_ref:
{style}

Using the attached reference image for this item's exact colours, texture and style, show the SAME {item} now {state}. View: {view}. Flat, fully transparent background, a soft contact shadow directly beneath it, nothing else in frame.

fields.camera: top-down, looking straight down at a worktop
fields.pose: flat relaxed hand resting palm-down on a worktop, fingers together -- the master reference every other pose and reskin is generated from
flat palm down, pressing and kneading dough
horizontal handle grip, fist closed around an invisible handle, as if holding a knife or ladle

fields.camera: eye level, back of the hand toward the viewer
fields.pose: pointing index finger extended, other fingers curled -- the default tap/point hand

fields.change: an embroidered kurti cuff in madder red with mirror-work, plus two or three thin glass bangles at the wrist

fields.item: a whole red onion with papery outer skin

fields.state: roughly diced into small pieces, scattered in a small pile
